name: keychain-key-off-macos-points-to-env
goal: `backendKey` reads a backend key given as `{ keychain: <service> }` from the macOS keychain. Off macOS (`process.platform` not `darwin`) there is no keychain, yet it still runs `/usr/bin/security` and reports `no keychain password`. Off macOS, skip the keychain lookup and throw `backend_key_missing` with a message telling the user to set `key.env` for that service; on macOS keep today's message.
